title: THE DOWNED NOISE
why: His order of 2026-10-12: have a downed noise, and anywhere a player voice was added, replace it with a distinct noise. Going down said I AM DOWN in a spoken voice (v24.57), which he hears as killing the vibe, and the rest of the party heard nothing at all. Going down now has its own sound that is never taken for a hit: a heavy body drop with a low muffled thump, a short dull ring like a concussion, and the world dips for about a second (everything else goes muffled, then opens again). Player 2 hears his own fall in his own window, on his side of the split speakers. A teammate going down is heard where he fell: the drop and the thump, panned and quieter with distance. The spoken DOWN bark is gone. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: Going down now lands with a heavy thump, a dull ring and a muffled world, and a teammate going down is heard where he fell.
